chunks: From him, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Amr ibn Ibrahim, from Al-Khurasani, who said:
Eating the sweet pomegranate increases the semen of the man and improves the offspring.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of eating sweet pomegranates according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi’s chapter on the pomegranate, this hadith from the Imams highlights the fruit's medicinal properties in enhancing male reproductive health by increasing semen volume and improving offspring quality. It reflects the Shia tradition of linking dietary habits to physical vitality and progeny, aligning with the broader Islamic emphasis on maintaining health as a trust from God.

en.hubeali: From him, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Amro Bin Ibrahim, from Al Khurasany who said,
‘Eating the sweet Pomegranate increases in the water of the man, and improves the childbirths’. (P.s. – This is not a Hadeeth)’.
en.sarwar: 17. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from ‘Amr ibn Ibrahim from al-Khurasaniy who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Eating sweet pomegranate increases one’s seed and forms the child well?”
